issue: विवसन विकट-सरुपा प्रलयमयी धारा — सरुपा (short u) is not a standard word; सरूपा ('having form') or स्वरूपा ('of fearsome form') is likely meant. Drik Panchang is the only witness; a web search found no independent printing.
तू अति गरलमना — गरलमना ('poison-minded') is rare; set against स्नेह-सुधामयि, it is read as the Goddess fierce and deadly (to the wicked).
our reading: Your mind is fierce as deadly poison.
alternatives: You are one who (like Śiva) holds poison in her mind / swallows poison
